summary: Last action within the remaining budget, with a real evidentiary effect rather than filler: the event finding's durable knowledge now cites its measured cluster consequence. Its mechanism statement, conditions and sources are unchanged; the entry gained the retained execution bbff5b4cad8f47129ee5997bb6eee815 at its decisive index — the run in which the shipped default event capacity leaves two of three nodes parked at 1024 unconsumed transitions, the healthy node's decided index frozen at 1129 before and after its write attempt, and that write ending in the documented Timeout, with the drained-stream control in the same execution. So the knowledge entry that states the blocking mechanism now also points at the observation that shows what it costs, which is consistent with the account already recorded for that question (capacity 8 cluster case plus the 64 node-local cases, corrected per-destination transport, superseded transport-jam run retained as an excluded cause). Final position as the run closes: four findings with receipts, knowledge and scoped limits — the event egress park and cluster stall; the core's missing accept-phase repair measured at two and three nodes with quorum-critical losses; append_notify's false Ok for an unadopted index with the adopted case shown truthful; and the actor layer's missing compaction path with the panic-to-Shutdown attribution chain. The single declared unfinished measurement remains the failure side of that last finding — a Storage whose write returns Err driven through the actor — which requires a delegating Storage wrapper and did not fit the remaining per-turn budget; its question's discriminator records exactly that.
